title_ar: الجواب الصحيح لمن بدل دين المسيح
title_es_or_en: Al-Jawab al-Sahih li-man baddala din al-Masih (Ibn Taymiyya; 'The Correct Answer to Whoever Changed the Religion of the Messiah')
edition_note: OpenITI/Shamela text 0000170 (versionUri 0728IbnTaymiyya.JawabSahih.Shamela0000170-ara1). #META# header: 6 vols; printed edition 'الثانية، 1419هـ / 1999م', publisher دار العاصمة، السعودية; editors علي بن حسن - عبد العزيز بن إبراهيم - حمدان بن محمد. Page markers PageV01P097 etc. give (vol, page) of that printed edition as recorded by Shamela. Not checked against the print itself.
genre: Theological refutation (polemic against Christian doctrine; quotes and answers a Christian letter attributed to Paul of Antioch, bishop of Sidon, in six sections)
notes: Ibn Taymiyya's own text: introduction (vol 1 pp. 97-104: occasion, summary of the letter's six sections, his method), then answers. The Christian text is quoted WITHOUT quotation marks: marked by 'قال الكاتب على لسان الأسقف' (vol 1 p.119), 'ذكروه في كتابهم' (vol 3 p.261), 'هذه ألفاظهم بأعيانها في الفصل الأول' (vol 1 p.122), and ordinary 'قالوا'. Literal quotation is clearly marked only for section 1 in my search; sections 2-6 are answered by topic headings ([فصل: ...]). Other OpenITI version of the same book: JK000330 (not used). Edition typo noted: 'والعقلية،،' (vol 1 p.98).

genre: Christian primary source (Melkite Arabic letter, c. 1200), SECONDARY access only
notes: Used only as christian_check. Bogataj (2019) states the letter has 64 short paragraphs and that Khoury's text is the critical edition (edited and translated into French, pp. 169-187 per Bogataj note 4). Bogataj's English quotations come from Dr Nafisa Abdelsadek's translation (ResearchGate 268216125), which I did not verify.

title_es_or_en: Jan Dominik Bogataj, 'Byzantine Theology and Islam: Paul of Antioch's Irenic Approach', Edinost in dialog 74 (2019) 2: 195-210
edition_note: DOI https://doi.org/10.34291/Edinost/74/02/Bogataj ; PDF fetched from https://www.teof.uni-lj.si/uploads/File/Edinost/74/02/Bogataj.pdf (saved in T7/dl/bogataj.pdf). Modern secondary article.
notes: Used for christian_check. Key points used: (a) Paul's letter is 'Risala ila Ahad al-Muslimin' (Letter to a Muslim Friend), 64 paragraphs, Khoury 1964 edition; (b) a Cypriot scholar revised the letter ('Letter from the People of Cyprus') and sent it to Damascus, reaching Ibn Taymiyya in 1316; (c) Paul uses 'name' (ism) rather than hypostasis (uqnum) for the Trinity; (d) paragraph quotations 7, 12, 25, 29, 33, 38, 60 (English). Paragraph numbers are Bogataj's citations of the Abdelsadek translation.
